v1_10_2.title: Full Async IO Overhaul: Non-Blocking Discover & Saves, Remote miuui Packages
highlights: Made Discover page (Nexus & Steam Workshop) fetching, card hydration, and prefetching fully asynchronous so loading never blocks UI interaction or tab switching
Offloaded blocking backend disk and network IO across Saves, Library, Profiles, archives, and wallpapers to background worker threads
changes: Converted Discover search, Steam Workshop worker queries, Nexus download/files, and translation commands to async spawn_blocking execution
Offloaded Saves slot scanning, backup/restore/sync, mod toggling/uninstallation, archive extraction, and custom wallpaper IO to background threads
Added main-thread yielding (scheduler.yield), background-priority prefetch scheduling, chunked card rendering, and request sequence guards on Discover and Saves pages
Migrated UI dependencies from local workspace links to published npm packages xcmm1543/miuui-* (v0.5.6)

v1_10_1.title: Fix Release Notes & Update Dialog Rendering, Tooltip Scrollbar & Drawer Backdrop
highlights: Fixed a vue-i18n compilation error in release notes strings that broke dialog rendering, restoring both startup release notes and update prompt dialogs
Unified Dialog and Drawer backdrop blur overlays and eliminated false scrollbars on short tooltips
changes: Fixed vue-i18n linked-message syntax conflict in v1.10.0 release notes and removed duplicate ReleaseNotesDialog instance in SettingsAbout
Restored current version display in the app update prompt dialog
Fixed short Tooltips displaying an unnecessary vertical scrollbar caused by arrow placement
Unified Drawer and Dialog backdrop blur overlays to match Dialog specs

v1_10_0.title: Full μui Design System Migration, Unified Motion & Dynamic Wallpaper Theme
highlights: Migrated the entire UI to the μui design system and OKLCH semantic token architecture, removing legacy wrappers and duplicate CSS
Unified spring motion language across all controls with sliding indicators, card glow lift, and consistent feedback even when Windows disables system animations
Upgraded custom wallpaper cropping to export transparent padding that adapts dynamically to light/dark themes, alongside updated frontend and Rust dependencies
changes: Adopted miuui/vue, miuui/tokens, and miuui/materials across AppBar, SideNav, cards, dialogs, drawers, switches, selects, pagination, tooltips, and skeletons
Unified spring interaction motion across all components, adding card hover glow/lift, overlay transitions, and subtle empty-state floating motion
Upgraded custom wallpaper cropping to export transparent margins and dynamically follow active light/dark theme gradients in preview and app background
Streamlined global styles and removed 8 obsolete local wrapper components while polishing Library, Discover, Saves, and Settings layouts
Fixed duplicate native title tooltip overlapping with custom tooltips and refined PageHeader divider spacing
Updated frontend packages (Vue, Vite, Tauri CLI, Vue Router, UnoCSS, Lucide, Oxlint) and Rust crates (Tauri 2.12, Zip 9.5, Reqwest, etc.)

v1_9_1.title: Preset Card Library Alignment & Discover Floating Pagination & Skeletons
highlights: Completely rebuilt preset management cards to fully align with Library ModCard design, frosted glass styling, and switch controls
Refactored Discover page pagination into a floating bottom pill that takes zero layout flow space, with bottom safe padding
Discover cards now naturally expand with content; unified grid and split view skeleton screens with 1:1 pixel precision
changes: Rebuilt preset cards into dedicated PresetCard component, matching ModCard frosted surfaces, typography, and NSwitch toggle
Converted Discover pagination bar into a floating overlay pill without taking up vertical layout space
Removed fixed height from discover cards; grid rows now naturally expand based on description and translation text
Unified skeleton loading screens for both grid and split views, adding result count placeholders to eliminate layout shift
Removed unwanted discolored ambient glow overlay from AppDialog, restoring pure frosted glass modal backgrounds
Fixed i18n key resolution error for preset export bundle button tooltip

v1_9_0.title: Nexus Mods Downloader & In-Library Preset Management
highlights: Integrated high-speed Nexus Mods downloader with download manager and automatic post-download installation
Streamlined preset workflow: removed dedicated preset page; manage, save, import and export presets directly inside Library
changes: Added Nexus Mods download and download manager with progress tracking, speed calculation, pause/resume, and auto-installation
Added Nexus account and Premium status verification in Settings to unlock direct high-speed downloads
Refactored presets: streamlined side navigation and added "Save as Preset" in Library to snapshot enabled mods
Added "Preset Management" modal in Library for switching, editing, deleting, and importing/exporting preset bundles

v1_8_7.title: Installer Experience Upgrade & Performance Improvements
highlights: Upgraded installer experience: defaults to direct in-place update when an older version is detected, preserving all personal configurations and mods
Greatly reduced memory consumption during mod processing and verification for smoother management of large mods
changes: Optimized Windows installer logic to default to direct overwrite update without uninstalling existing user data
Optimized mod file verification pipeline, significantly cutting memory usage and boosting performance
Improved asset bundling and code splitting for faster startup and smoother page navigation
Updated core runtime libraries to enhance overall app stability and performance

v1_8_6.title: Multi-Version Mod Conflict Management & Precise Instance Targeting
highlights: Added automatic multi-version mod conflict detection and a dedicated Version Retention Panel with one-click cleanup
Refactored mod uninstall and folder location to use precise physical file paths, completely resolving accidental deletion across versions
changes: Added Version Retention Panel: visual version comparison, switch active version, keep & clean old versions, delete specific instance
Fixed critical bug where deleting a disabled mod with duplicate ID mistakenly uninstalled the enabled version
Added multi-version conflict badge (⚠️), conflict quick filter, and mutual exclusion guard preventing duplicate active versions
Optimized mod operations and fixed duplicate DOM key collisions for multi-instance mods
